audience: warehouse and inventory managers who track stock levels, orders and suppliers in inFlow

useCases.title: Check stock levels for a product
useCases.text: Find the product in the product list, then read its quantity on hand, on order, reserved and on transfer. Limit the stock to one location.

useCases.title: Review sales orders waiting to ship
useCases.text: List sales orders and quotes, and open one to read its lines, payment status and shipping state.

useCases.title: Review purchase orders and their supplier
useCases.text: List purchase orders, and open one to read its lines, receiving and payment state. Open the vendor record for addresses, balances and lead time.

useCases.title: Correct stock after a count or damage
useCases.text: List the adjustment reasons, such as damage or count correction. Then add or remove stock at one location; the change applies at once.

useCases.title: Update a product record
useCases.text: Read a product's costs, prices and tracking settings. Update it with the timestamp from the read, so a newer edit is not overwritten.
